title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Nothing new with Nick and an extension, right?
Not for use, just covering bases. Seems like everyone is getting one
Your manager pushed every right button tonight. He was two innings ahead of Boone all night
That’s why I hired him. Plus we give him and his staff more info than he has ever had.
For that matter more than any Manager we have ever had.
